浦和レッズは、6日後に同じ問題を解き直す。東京V戦は岡山戦の「追試」になる

Before Urawa Reds vs Tokyo Verdy on September 19, 2026, this essay reads Urawa through their first seven league matches. Every match has produced a winner, with 13 goals scored and 17 conceded. Yet the first five games were 11-15, while the last two compressed to 2-2. The Verdy match revisits a problem exposed by Okayama: attack before the block resets, then move it once it is set. The deeper test is whether Urawa can choose the tempo of a match rather than simply live inside its chaos.
